page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is a general-purpose server instance configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base clock frequency of 2.9 GHz on x86_64 architecture. It features 512 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 resource allocation ratio of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance runs under a KVM hypervisor and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

The ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge server configuration does not include local storage disks or hardware GPU accelerators, relying entirely on remote cloud block storage for persistent data requirements. The absence of integrated disk hardware simplifies node management while requiring external volume attachments for operational storage. Qualitatively, the combination of 128 execution threads and 64 Gbps baseline network throughput offers high hardware density and interconnect performance for non-accelerated compute loads.

Given its balanced ratio of processing cores to system memory and high network capacity, this instance fits enterprise backend applications, distributed software compilation, large-scale web serving, container orchestration, and network-bound processing tasks.
